annotation.title_clean: Kerajaan Ambil Langkah Proaktif Menangani Implikasi Etika, Undang-Undang Berkaitan Kecerdasan Buatan
annotation.title_en: Government Takes Proactive Steps to Address Ethical and Legal Implications Related to Artificial Intelligence
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Unit Komunikasi Korporat, Kementerian Digital (Ministry of Digital, Malaysia)
named_instruments_referenced: Malaysia National Guidelines on AI Governance and Ethics (AIGE)
annotation.summary_en: Malaysian Ministry of Digital media release (23 Oct 2024) on Minister Gobind Singh Deo's parliamentary reply about AI ethical, legal, economic and social implications. It highlights the National Guidelines on AI Governance and Ethics (AIGE), launched by MOSTI on 20 September 2024, based on seven principles for responsible AI.
key_provisions_or_claims: MOSTI launched the AIGE guidelines on 20 September 2024.
AIGE adopts seven key principles for responsible AI development and use.
Ministry of Digital helped refine the guidelines.
Guidelines cover users, policymakers, designers, providers and suppliers across the AI ecosystem.
Aim is AI for public well-being while respecting human rights and individual security.
